verdict.rationale: Teams' own developer platform documents in-conversation app surfaces: message extensions, suggested actions (button-like replies), agent slash commands and tab apps. That shows a first-party app-UI platform inside chat, but the evidence pack contains only headings, with no detail on modals/dialogs or structured card layouts. missing for 10: documented modal/dialog support, structured message layout (card) framework, interactive button handling details, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build apps with rich interactive UI inside chat — modals, buttons, and structured message layouts
